name: v1.0.0-beta
body:
OpenZT2 is in early development and requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 Ultimate Collection game files.

The [package guide](https://github.com/overyonder/openzt2/blob/v1.0.0-beta/tools/release/README.md) covers installation and runtime requirements.

name: v0.7.0-alpha
body:
Early alpha. Gameplay remains incomplete and known bugs are tracked in Issues.

Packages: Windows x64 (.zip), macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg), Linux x64 (.deb, .rpm, .pkg.tar.zst, AppImage and Flatpak). Native Linux packages and AppImage require glibc 2.39 or newer and the system libraries listed in the Linux packaging documentation; Flatpak uses its own runtime. See tools/release/linux/README.md for installation and game-file locations.

Requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 game files. They are not included. These packages have not yet been verified through complete gameplay sessions on all three platforms.


<!-- fixed-issues:start -->

name: v0.4.0-alpha
body:
Fixes in this release:

- The Load Game dialog fits the screen and loads the save you select (#39).
- The options screen keeps its Back and Apply buttons after you apply a setting (#41).
- Campaign mode lists its campaigns and scenarios again (#52).
- Purchase details no longer overlap or show stale information, and the purchase panel closes (#64, #62).
- The mouse wheel zooms out from rest (#78).
- The Overhead View button returns from guest mode (#82).
- The game no longer crashes at startup on macOS (#185).

Early alpha. Gameplay remains incomplete and known bugs are tracked in Issues.

Packages: Windows x64 (.zip), macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg), Linux x64 (.deb, Ubuntu 24.04 or compatible).

Requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 game files. They are not included. These packages have not yet been verified through complete gameplay sessions on all three platforms.

name: Version 0.1.0 - Pre-Alpha
body: - Initial release for Windows, Linux, and macOS. Expect regular updates adding parity with original game features and appearance. This is a pre-alpha and is not yet production ready. Do not report bugs as we have catalogued those already. Have feature requests or suggestions, add a pull request on our repo.
